title: Red Bridge Cooking School Masterclass
description: A comprehensive farm-to-table masterclass in Hoi An, starting at the central market and ending in a tropical riverside pavilion. Curated by AGS.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The Red Bridge Cooking School offers a 5-hour, farm-to-table masterclass in Hoi An, [Vietnam](/destinations/vietnam/), beginning at the central market and concluding at a tropical riverside pavilion after a 25-minute private boat cruise on the Thu Bon River. Participants learn to prepare classic Vietnamese dishes such as Cao Lau, Mi Quang, fresh rice paper rolls, and Vietnamese eggplant in a clay pot.
> *   This experience, available year-round with advance booking required, has low physical demand and is best paired with a cultural exploration day in Hoi An Ancient Town. Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this educational and serene culinary activity.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
A comprehensive farm-to-table masterclass in Hoi An, starting at the central market and ending in a tropical riverside pavilion.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Established as one of the pioneers in elevating Vietnamese culinary education, Red Bridge demystifies complex regional dishes like Cao Lau and Mi Quang, preserving traditional methods while teaching modern plating.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Navigate the chaotic beauty of Hoi An central market to identify specific herbs. Board a private boat for a leisurely 25-minute cruise along the Thu Bon River, arriving at the school's secluded compound. 

Under the watchful eye of the executive chef, prepare classic dishes like fresh rice paper rolls and Vietnamese eggplant in a clay pot. The session culminates in the open-air dining pavilion.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Educational, Serene, Hands-on |
| **Duration** | 5 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low (Standing in kitchen) |
| **Best Paired With** | A cultural exploration day in Hoi An Ancient Town. |

## Integrating Red Bridge’s Thu Bon River Pavilion With Hoi An & Da Nang Tee Sheets
Situated on two lush riverside acres along the Hoi An River just 10 minutes from [Anantara Hoi An Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/anantara-hoi-an/), [Namia River Retreat](/accommodations/vietnam/namia-river-retreat-hoi-an/), and our curated [An Bang Beachfront Villas](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/)—and 20 minutes north of Robert Trent Jones Jr.’s [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/) and [Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An](/courses/vietnam/vinpearl-nam-hoi-an/)—the **Red Bridge Cooking School Masterclass** is Central Vietnam’s benchmark culinary day out. On [Hoi An Beachfront Bliss](/tours/hoi-an-beachfront-bliss/) and [Da Nang & Hoi An Coastal Links](/tours/da-nang-hoi-an-coastal-links/), groups deploy Red Bridge in two ways:
1. **Mid-Tour Recovery Day Between Links Rounds:** After back-to-back tournament days at [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/) and [Ba Na Hills Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/ba-na-hills/), spend a relaxed morning strolling Hoi An’s colorful central wet market with Red Bridge’s chef, cruising 25 minutes down the Thu Bon River aboard a private wooden launch, and cooking a four-course lunch in the breezy riverside pavilion—followed by a private swim in Red Bridge’s 20-meter pool.
2. **Parallel Non-Golfer Experience With Shared Lunch:** Non-golfing spouses enjoy the morning market walk, river cruise, and hands-on cooking class while golfers play an 07:00 AM round at [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/) or [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/), with the golfers arriving at the riverside pavilion at 12:30 PM to share the feast.

## Private Wok Stations & Signature Quang Nam Recipes
* **Market-to-Boat-to-Pavilion Flow:** Your chef introduces your group to Hoi An’s spice merchants, explaining the difference between fermented Phu Quoc fish sauce, *tương ớt* Hoi An chili jam, water morning glory, and aromatic perilla leaf before boarding your private river boat.
* **Four Classic Central Coast Dishes:** At individual open-air cooking stations, guests master crispy *Bánh Xèo* rice-flour crepes, fresh Hoi An shrimp spring rolls with peanut dipping sauce, fragrant clay-pot caramelized eggplant or ocean fish, and hand-cut seafood *Phở* or *Cao Lầu* noodles.

faqs.q: How close is Red Bridge Cooking School to Hoiana Shores Golf Club and Hoi An's luxury villas?
faqs.a: Red Bridge's riverside compound sits just 10 minutes from An Bang Beachfront Villas, Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai, and Anantara Hoi An, and 20 minutes north of Hoiana Shores Golf Club and Montgomerie Links.

faqs.q: Can golfers join non-golfing partners for lunch at the end of the Red Bridge Cooking Class?
faqs.a: Yes. While non-golfing partners complete the 8:15 AM market tour, river boat cruise, and cooking session, golfers teeing off early at Hoiana Shores or BRG Da Nang can transfer straight to Red Bridge's riverside pavilion at 12:30 PM for a shared private lunch.

faqs.q: Is there a private option at Red Bridge for a golf group of 6 to 12 travelers?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Asia Golf Specialists arranges private chef-led market walks, a dedicated Thu Bon River boat charter, and an exclusive cooking pavilion for groups of 4 to 16 guests.
